Morocco to Boost Local Defence Production with $401 Million Investment

Morocco's King Mohammed VI has directed a $401 million investment into the country's defense industry. The goal is to achieve 40% local production of defense needs by 2035, creating an estimated 50,000 jobs and generating 65% export revenue. This initiative positions Morocco as Africa's top arms importer aiming for increased self-sufficiency.
